title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named University Park destinations for studying, making, viewing art, gathering, or informal recreation, each supported by a direct Penn State source.

cards.title: HUB-Robeson Center
cards.subtitle: 288 Pollock Road
cards.notes: Use the central gathering space to meet classmates, attend a campus event, or locate student organizations and services between commitments.
cards.short_summary: A central campus building for student organizations, events, collaboration, and connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Student Affairs describes the HUB–Robeson Center as its central campus gathering space, bringing together students, organizations, and resources.
cards.source_title: HUB-Robeson Center | Penn State Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Consult the HUB page or building staff for event-specific access and room availability.

cards.title: Engagement Space
cards.subtitle: HUB-Robeson Center
cards.notes: Stop by to explore out-of-classroom opportunities and ask staff about goals, engagement options, and next steps for getting involved.
cards.short_summary: A staffed HUB space focused on helping students explore engagement opportunities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Engagement Network says its University Park Engagement Space in the HUB is equipped with tools and staff to help students identify goals and opportunities.
cards.source_title: Engagement Space at University Park | Student Engagement Network
cards.access_notes: Located in the HUB-Robeson Center; check the Student Engagement Network for current programming.

cards.title: HUB-Robeson Galleries
cards.subtitle: HUB Gallery, Art Alley, and first-floor exhibition cases
cards.notes: Take a self-guided art break in the HUB Gallery, Art Alley, or exhibition cases; personal photography is encouraged unless posted otherwise.
cards.short_summary: Rotating contemporary-art and student-facing exhibitions distributed through the HUB.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State states that exhibitions in the HUB Gallery, Art Alley, exhibition cases, and public HUB spaces are free and open to all.
cards.source_title: HUB-Robeson Galleries | Penn State Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Listed gallery hours are Monday through Friday, 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; exhibitions rotate.

cards.title: Pattee and Paterno Libraries
cards.subtitle: Library study spaces and computer labs
cards.notes: Settle into a study area, use computers or printers, and check the library’s current services before planning a group work session.
cards.short_summary: The main University Park library complex supports individual and group academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State IT lists computer labs, hallway stations, and printers in Pattee/Paterno Library, and the Libraries describe study and collaboration spaces there.
cards.source_title: Computer Lab Locations | Penn State Information Technology
cards.access_notes: Penn State IT publishes current computer-lab hours; library access and services can vary by term.

cards.title: Collaboration Commons
cards.subtitle: Ground floor, Pattee and Paterno Libraries
cards.notes: Use this ground-floor library area when you need a collaborative setting, then check the Libraries’ reservation system for eligible study rooms.
cards.short_summary: A named library area designed around group study, collaboration, and technology-supported work.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State identifies the Collaboration Commons as a ground-floor space in Pattee and Paterno Libraries and describes its study and collaboration functions.
cards.source_title: Pattee Library renovation to expand student study, collaboration spaces | Penn State
cards.access_notes: Group-study room access and reservations are subject to current University Libraries policies.

cards.title: Palmer Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: 650 Bigler Road
cards.notes: Browse current exhibitions at your own pace, or look for a scheduled drop-in tour, gallery talk, workshop, or Art After Hours program.
cards.short_summary: Penn State’s campus art museum, next to the Arboretum on Bigler Road.
cards.evidence_claim: The Palmer Museum of Art is located at 650 Bigler Road on Penn State’s University Park campus and offers free admission with a suggested donation.
cards.access_notes: The museum lists Wednesday–Sunday hours and Thursday evening hours; it is closed Monday, Tuesday, and University holidays.

cards.title: The Arboretum at Penn State
cards.subtitle: East Park Avenue and Bigler Road
cards.notes: Walk the H.O. Smith Botanic Gardens or the surrounding Arboretum grounds during daylight, and use the official maps to choose a route.
cards.short_summary: A mapped botanical landscape at the northeast edge of the University Park campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arboretum is open daily from dawn to dusk, and Penn State states there is no admission charge for its botanic gardens or land beyond them.
cards.source_title: Hours, Admission, Directions, Parking | The Arboretum at Penn State
cards.access_notes: Open every day from dawn until dusk; observe posted visitor policies and use official Arboretum maps.

cards.title: Alumni Gardens
cards.subtitle: Around the Hintz Family Alumni Center
cards.notes: Walk the connected garden areas, ponds, and waterfall, then pause at a seating area while staying on the maintained paths and respecting events.
cards.short_summary: A one-acre cluster of named garden areas beside the alumni center.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Alumni Association says the Alumni Gardens surround the Hintz Family Alumni Center and include five distinct garden areas; its visitor page notes students and community members gather there.
cards.source_title: Hintz Family Alumni Center | Penn State Alumni Association
cards.access_notes: The gardens surround an active alumni-center facility; be mindful of scheduled functions and posted guidance.

cards.title: Outdoor Pickleball Courts
cards.subtitle: Beside McCoy Natatorium on Curtin Road
cards.notes: Bring a friend for informal play at the courts beside McCoy Natatorium, and plan your visit within the published daylight operating window.
cards.short_summary: Twelve outdoor courts for informal pickleball near the natatorium.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Campus Recreation identifies twelve Outdoor Pickleball Courts beside McCoy Natatorium on Curtin Road and says they are open daily from sunup to sundown for informal play.
cards.source_title: Recreation Facilities | Penn State Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Open daily from sunup to sundown for informal play; follow current Campus Recreation facility guidelines.

cards.title: Park Avenue Intramural Fields
cards.subtitle: North of East Halls
cards.notes: Gather a group for informal outdoor play in this grass complex, and check Campus Recreation information for scheduled intramural activity or reservations.
cards.short_summary: A 12-acre grass field complex north of East Halls for activities and informal play.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Campus Recreation identifies the Park Avenue Intramural Fields as a 12-acre grass complex north of East Halls that hosts intramural competitions, student activities, and informal play.
cards.source_title: Recreation Facilities | Penn State Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Campus Recreation lists this area for intramural competitions, student activities, informal play, and reservations.
